note: H200 — S91 five-seat quorum: the seat is a string. ATTACKER-1, 2026-08-19.

controls.name: s91_reproduces
controls.must_fire_because: a kill that cannot reproduce the result it kills is not a kill
controls.can_fail_because: any of the four reported lines differing from the published 69/69, 5/5, 0, True
controls.null_must_contain: the run must be capable of producing different numbers -- it does, under C3, where one altered seat moves divergences from 0 to 74

controls.name: seat_never_read
controls.must_fire_because: the entire charge is that five votes are one computation repeated
controls.can_fail_because: any seat, or the None/{}/fake agents, producing a different output vector would raise the count above 1
controls.null_must_contain: the probe must be capable of returning MORE than one distinct vector -- it returns 74 distinct digests across jobs in the same run, so the collapse is across SEATS and not a flat instrument
controls.detail: 8 probes (5 real seats + None + {} + a fabricated seat) -> 1 distinct output vector; a None agent votes identically to the Gemini lead

controls.name: adjudicator_still_works
controls.must_fire_because: distinguish the evidence from the conclusion: what dies is that anything was independently executed, NOT the adjudication logic
controls.can_fail_because: if one seat returning a wrong digest had still reported 0 divergences, the machinery would be broken too and this control would read 0
controls.null_must_contain: the adjudicator must be capable of reporting 0 -- it does, on every unmodified run, which is C1
controls.detail: one seat forced to return a zero digest -> all 74 jobs flagged

controls.name: artifacts_restored
controls.must_fire_because: S91 is UNTRACKED, so its artifacts have no committed copy; a probe that ran its main() and did not restore would destroy them again
controls.can_fail_because: attack.py asserts byte-equality after restoring and raises rather than continuing if it differs
controls.null_must_contain: the restore must be capable of FAILING -- the assertion compares bytes and raises, and the snapshot is taken before any patched run
controls.detail: restored byte-identical; `git ls-files spikes/S91_multi_agent_quorum/` returns 0 files, which is why there was nothing to restore FROM

controls.name: class_sweep_finds_its_known_positive
controls.must_fire_because: a sweep that cannot find the instance it was written for is inert and its zero would mean nothing (H85)
controls.can_fail_because: classsweep.py asserts the known positive is present and refuses the run otherwise
controls.null_must_contain: the sweep must be capable of returning nothing for a file -- it returns nothing for 341 of 344
controls.detail: 344 files, 3 independence-shaped hits of which 1 is this class and 2 are dead parameters; 2 constructed variants it cannot see, so the count is a FLOOR

falsifiers.refutes: the seats are genuinely independent, my charge is false, row WITHDRAWN
